instances.claim: This tells me that Rutherford Chang chose the penny because Brenner's Lincoln is the most reproduced artwork on Earth.
instances.why: Line 2 holds the decision expression ('chose', attributed to a person); line 1, immediately before it, states a property of the object (most reproduced artwork on Earth), and the deictic 'This is the readymade' binds the two so the property reads as the selection criterion. The draft states no reason, motive or origin for Chang's choice anywhere — lines 14–20 give an argument about commodification and objecthood for CENTS, not for his selection — so the sequence supplies the only motive on offer.
